work.description: Entire XXV extended across the false D heading LF19291 through own datum LF19380–19383, with20LF context read. All §§1–5 and own marginal summaries retained, only false glyph/page/running furniture excluded. Marginal date reads13 July, closing OCR xii July; discrepancy retained, normalized date null. Earlier Urbani letters are referenced, not offered as an absent annex. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
